title: Moominpappa at Sea
description: The end of August: everything in the valley is done, and Moominpappa takes his family to a bare island with a dark lighthouse. Each of them looks for a place of their own there — and each finds a loneliness. Whom does Papa notice, and whom does he miss?
line: A bare island, a dark lighthouse, one lantern for the whole family — and whom will Papa give it to?
source: after the novel by Tove Jansson
